## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated (and `npm run test:e2e` if generators, templates or the CLI changed)
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/*.md`) if behaviour changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in the diff
- [ ] No new runtime dependency, or the reason is documented in `ARCHITECTURE.md`
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
